124: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.
Before Sam was murdered, he told Molly he'd love and protect her forever.

There's no such thing as free cable.

A story of two friends who didn't know they were supposed to be enemies.
1660: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. There are angels on the streets of Berlin.

Get ready to kick some grass!

Fate of one. Future of all.

A trip back in time from the present to...

Traveling around the world, Maher examines the tenets of Christianity, Judaism and Islam and raises questions about homosexuality, proof of Christ's existence, Jewish Sabbath laws, violent Muslim extremists.

A Dangerous Mind is a terrible thing to waste.

Deception is their most dangerous weapon.

4220: Two men in 1930s Mississippi become friends after being sentenced to life in prison together for a crime they did not commit.
Share it with someone you love.

A comedy about the journey between popping the question and tying the knot.

Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise, kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.
The horror film with a heart of mystery.

Birth and death are extraordinary experiences. Life is a fleeting pleasure.
5244: In the aftermath of an unspeakable act of terror, Police Sergeant Tommy Saunders joins courageous survivors, first responders and investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the Boston Marathon bombers before they strike again.
The inside story of the world's greatest manhunt.

Liberation. Whether they want it or not.

Lawrence 'Larry' Stewart Talbot / The Wolf Man

Protecting witnesses is a challenge. Living with them is impossible.

Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down.

8060: Foreign Legion officer Galoup recalls his once glorious life, training troops in the Gulf of Djibouti. His existence there was happy, strict and regimented, until the arrival of a promising young recruit, Sentain, plants the seeds of jealousy in Galoup's mind.
8316: Private eye Philip Marlowe investigates a case of blackmail involving the two wild daughters of a rich general, a pornographer and a gangster.
Meet Philip Marlowe. The toughest private eye who ever wore a trench coat, slapped a dame and split his knuckles on a jawbone.
8572: A series of mysterious events changes the life of a blind pianist who now must report a crime that was actually never witnessed by him.
8828: US Ranger Captain Artemis and her team are part of a UN joint security mission north of Hemat, in Afghanistan. Behind our world, there is another.

King Fausto of the Sixth Dimension
Queen Doris of the Sixth Dimension
10620: The story of an imaginative boy who pretends he is the child of a sperm-laden Sicilian tomato upon which his mother accidentally fell.
Growing Up Can Be Painfully Funny.

It will take you into a surreal world of passion and sexuality, further than most would dare to go.
11644: Desperate for a good story, a sex-addicted journalist throws himself into the world of high-class escorts when he starts following a Stanford-educated prostitute.

TODAY - THE POND... TOMORROW - THE WORLD!
12156: Mr. Johnny First goes to the Wild West to present the art of the Cinematograph, and the lives of everyone in the frontier town of Santa Carolina change as a result of this.

12668: At the turn of the century, all of the Earth's monsters have been rounded up and kept safely on Monsterland. Chaos erupts when a race of she-aliens known as the Kilaaks unleash the monsters across the world.
The mysterious Kilaaks appear! Shaking the universe, the great battle of 11 monsters!
13180: A freak tsunami traps shoppers at a coastal Australian supermarket inside the building ... along with a 12-foot great white shark.
A Tsunami Just Flipped The Foodchain.
13948: Danny O'Brien is back in action fighting the notorious Simon Moon, also known as The Terror. Three years earlier O'Brien had single-handedly captured The Terror and was called Hero by the people of L.A. Now Simon has escaped and has started killing women again, and O'Brien is the only man who can stop him.
14460: An awkward, unemployed man who can talk to the dead teams up with a rebellious bartender to find the vengeful ghost that's been terrorizing their town.
This dead end town just got a lot deader.
14716: A ticking-clock thriller following Winston Churchill in the 24 hours before D-Day.
14972: Platon is travelling by train to visit his father. He gets off to have lunch where he meets Vera, a waitress. He refuses to pay for the food after which a series of unfortunate events unfold for the pair.

Love is all there is… until your parents find out.
16252: Two Russian prisoners are abused mentally and physically.
16508: Based on the true story of two chambermaids of 1930s France who murdered their employer and her daughter.
It wasn't just a crime.  It was a crime of passion.

All the action you can take...all the adventure you can wish for!

17788: After running away from her abusive mother, a streetwise teen seeks refuge with her father, but he rejects her when he learns that she's pregnant.
Sometimes you have to leave home to find your family.

Life is a force of nature

Makes "Night of the Living Dead" Look Like a Kids' Pajama Party!
19324: A mild-mannered secretary discovers that she has a talent for murder as she ascends the corporate ladder.
Climbing the corporate ladder can be murder.

This accident causes Omer's pregnant wife Inci, who was in the back seat, to have a pre-term labor. The babies are born on the same day. They see each other for the first time... This accident is the threshold of the coincidences that bring Ozgur and Deniz together.
19836: Explore the rise and fall of one of the biggest corporate flameouts and venture capitalist bubbles in recent years – the story of WeWork, and its hippie-messianic leader Adam Neumann.
Fake it until you break it.

The Incredible True Story of Formula One's Greatest Family.
20348: Follows six very different men and their struggles with women, family and work. Yet, they are somehow connected to each other.
20604: From America's greatest beardsman, to Morgan Spurlock's own mustache, Executive Producers Will Arnett, Jason Bateman, and Ben Silverman bring us a hilarious look at men's identity in the 21st century. 22140: Seventeen-year-olds Miku and Elias find themselves, and each other, during a summer in the Finnish countryside.
This nordic summer is all about being screwed

They don't get a lot of Deutsch-marks as they planned but instead, they end up on a ship going to Poland, together with bunches and bunches of Polish Zlotys (the Polish currency). In Poland, they discover that the mafia are very interested in that money and Wall-Enberg is working with the mafia.
22652: Teenagers from a small town and their high school science teacher join forces to battle a giant mutant spider, living in a cave nearby and getting hungry.
The Spider will eat you alive!
23164: Jin-a, a young prostitute, moves into a seaside motel called the Birdcage Inn, run by a dysfunctional family. Same age, same space and different life…
23420: Based on the true story of IPS officer Manoj Kumar Sharma, 12th Fail sheds limelight on fearlessly embracing the idea of restarting the academic journey despite the setbacks and challenges and reclaiming one's destiny at a place where millions of students attempt the world's toughest competitive exam: UPSC.
23676: Since his wife's death, Victor has raised his daughter Angela alone. After she and her friend return from a three-day disappearance with missing memories, they begin displaying frightening behavior reminiscent of the MacNeil possession fifty years prior.
23932: Expert thief Parker gets a shot at a major heist, but to pull it off he and his team must outsmart a South American dictator, the New York mob, and the world's richest man.
24188: A decades-spanning tale of love and resilience and of one woman's journey to independence. Celie faces many hardships in her life, but ultimately finds extraordinary strength and hope in the unbreakable bonds of sisterhood.
A bold new take on the beloved classic.
24444: A gangster in Malaysia goes in search of his family after 25 years of imprisonment.
24700: Besieged by writer’s block and the crushing breakup with Tessa, Hardin travels to Portugal in search of a woman he wronged in the past – and to find himself. Hoping to win back Tessa, he realizes he needs to change his ways before he can make the ultimate commitment.
24956: After escaping from a mental hospital, a violent sociopath named Paul begins a dangerous rampage targeting Sofia, a world-famous pop star. Obsessed with her, he takes Sofia hostage in her own home, acting under the delusional belief that they are getting married. Paul is desperate to prove his devotion, leading to a tense and unpredictable situation.
You're cordially invited to a violently romantic comedy.
25212: When a man is found dead, the investigation shatters his widow's perfect facade and exposes a hidden double life in this thriller based on real events.
25468: Aaditya, the commissioner of Mumbai Police, sets out to catch Ajay, a drug peddler. However, he uncovers a deeper controversy linked to an international drug lord and must mete out justice.
To battle monsters, become a monster.
25724: A team of con men fall for a Begum and her female confidante. Does their love fructify?
25980: Plunging into a virtual reminiscence challenge to assuage his sorrow, a heartbroken dad uncovers a shocking revelation about Frida Soman, his long-admired icon and globally beloved luminary.
26236: Expert conman Joe Thanks teams up with half-breed Bill and naive Lucy to steal $300,000 from the Indian-hating Major Cabot. Their elaborate plan is full of disguises, double-crosses, and chases, but Joe always seems to know what he's doing.
In the saddle... In the sack... In the sand
26492: The Hartmann family is turned upside down when mother Angelika decides to take in the refugee Diallo, against her husband's will. Amidst the typical chaos of our time, hope remains that the family finds its stability, confidence and peace again - just like the whole country.
26748: Two guys and a female hitchhiker are terrorized by a monstrous looking man driving a giant monster truck.
On this highway the roadkill... is human!
27004: A collection of seven stories "from the block," linked by the theme of the seven deadly sins, humorously portrays the everyday life of New Belgrade's inhabitants, who are consumed by their minor foibles and guided by their passions. 27260: Baron, an imprisoned man, strikes up a friendship with cellmate Otis. As the pair hatch an escape plan together, Baron recalls the story of how he met Marmalade, the love of his life, and their Bonnie and Clyde scheme to rob a bank in order to care for his sick mother and give the couple the life they’ve always dreamed of.
Their love was the ultimate getaway.
27516: After the death of his father, a boy growing up on a lunar mining colony takes a trip to explore a legendary crater, along with his four best friends, prior to being permanently relocated to another planet.
Miles from Earth, their adventure begins.
27772: Hell – A place where beings that have committed mortal sins during their lifetime are sent. It is a realm where even Soul Reapers are forbidden to interfere. 28028: A high school girl wakes up each day with no memory of yesterday. When she agrees to date a shy classmate, can their love grow with every new beginning?
One night... One love... A thousand goodbyes...

Anna has to leave everything behind, including her beloved pink rabbit, and to face a new life full of challenges and privations abroad.
A Family's Escape. A Childhood Lost.
29052: For Sebastian Silverberg life is all about his appearance, partying and his enormous ego. Things are going smoothly when an accident leaves him blind, forcing him to re-evaluate his life and to seek meaning beyond appearances.

And there's buried treasure...$2 million dollars just waiting for someone to dig it up. Rodney is hooked. But there's just one slight, itty-bitty problem...he doesn't have a shovel. Oh, and the $2 million dollars just happens to be in cocaine form.
Self - Homeland Security SRT Team (archive footage) (credit only)
29564: Ellie, a recovering drug addict, has just moved to a new city with her two teenage children. Unfortunately, new friends, a new job, and the chance of a new life, can’t keep Ellie from slipping once again. Her life changes when she meets Christopher – a different kind of addict – which forces her daughter and son to accept a new version of Ellie.
29820: Karthik hails from Rayalaseema and is doing well in his career as a project lead in an IT company. Wanting to pursue the family’s vocation of farming, he quits his job and returns back to his village. Will he be able to bring back lost glory to the profession?

Hear the voices that power could not silence.

Hollinger's father, however, is not satisfied with Gaines's results, and attempts to investigate the case on his own.
She's the call girl. He's the cop. They both take their jobs seriously.

But when she realizes Kai is committing brutal murders at each stop, it's too late to walk away. Six hours. Five hits. Who will survive?

The Pen is mightier than The Sword
31868: After her sister dies, Anjali gives up her relationship with Raja and marries her brother-in-law. Years later, they cross paths again, leaving her torn between him and her loyalties.

A handful is all you need.
